text_block_list.text: Heading to school gate after class—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ............1 minute remaining until next scheduled event.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No time left to wait for Falcon-san.
Must depart for Oi Racecourse immediately.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Strict punctuality is mandatory for smooth execution.
Start time must be maintained under all circumstances—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...However.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hm-hm-hmm♪
Really looking forward to UMA-Sta tonight~☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Falcon-san.
Fortuitous timing, I have question.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Question for Falco~? Sure thing!
Falco's three sizes are~...☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That information is unnecessary.
You are well-acquainted with Oi Racecourse, correct?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To spectate today's 11R, scheduled departure from
academy is 18:00. Regarding shortest route from each station—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, 18:00!? N-No way!
It's not like Tokyo Racecourse, you know!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Lots of transfers, plus rush hour.
If anything happens, you won't make it in time!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Mhm, looks like Flash-san really
isn't used to Oi at all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Then Falco will guide you☆
Both how to watch Oi, and how to enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Eh...? But did you not have
your own schedule?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine♪
Rely on your friends sometimes☆
Besides, I know best seats at Oi☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Let us observe just bit longer.
Can wait 1 more minute, after all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Flash-saaan! Sorry, so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Phew~, sorry for being right down to the wire~☆
But Falco made meeting time, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: No, you are 2 seconds late.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, we shall run to Oi.
In order for both of us to view race from good seats.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? R-Running!?
It was only 2 seconds though~~!

And so, Eishin Flash ran off with
smiling Smart Falcon.
